titleEn: 50 years later, Amory Lovins’ soft energy path meets electrification
titleZh: 五十年后，阿莫里·洛文斯的“软能源路径”与电气化相遇
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: Hurricane Belle was barreling toward New England in August 1976 when an editor from Foreign Affairs called. Physicist Amory Lovins took the call on a payphone in a shack in the Maine woods, where he spent summers as a camp guide.
paragraphs.zh: 1976年8月，飓风贝儿正向新英格兰逼近，《外交事务》的一位编辑打来电话，物理学家阿莫里·洛文斯在缅因州森林里的一个棚屋里用公用电话接了电话，他在那里做夏令营向导。

paragraphs.en: “If it happened to hit that area, the wires would be down with trees on them for weeks, so we’d miss the press date,” Lovins told me in a 2025 interview. The lines held up as he and the editor worked through final edits on a 14-hour phone call.
paragraphs.zh: 洛文斯在2025年的一次采访中告诉我："如果它碰巧击中了那个地区，电线会被树木压上几个星期，所以我们会错过新闻发布日期。"他和编辑在14个小时的电话中进行最后的编辑时，电话线一直在工作。

paragraphs.en: Published in October 1976 in the wake of the 1973 oil crisis, “Energy Strategy: The Road Not Taken?” drew more reprint requests than any Foreign Affairs article in decades.
paragraphs.zh: 1973年石油危机之后，《能源战略：不走的路？》于1976年10月出版，吸引了数十年来最多的转载请求。

paragraphs.en: Two U.S. Senate committees called on the 29-year-old Lovins to testify about his ideas that December. The following year, Lovins met with President Jimmy Carter and his top energy advisers in the Oval Office and expanded his article into a book, “Soft Energy Paths: Toward a Durable Peace.” The New York Times chronicled the “raging debate” sparked by Lovins, noting that “even his critics concede that he is something of a genius.”
paragraphs.zh: 同年12月，两个美国参议院委员会要求29岁的洛文斯就他的想法作证。第二年，洛文斯在椭圆形办公室会见了吉米·卡特总统和他的高级能源顾问，并将他的文章扩展成一本书，《软能源之路：《纽约》记录了洛文斯引发的"激烈辩论"，他指出，"即使是他的批评者也承认他是一个天才。"

paragraphs.en: The article charted two paths for the future of energy. One, which Lovins called the “hard” path, required ever more energy supply to meet inexorably rising demand. With U.S. oil production in decline since 1970, coal and uranium would supply most growth by generating electricity at large, remote facilities.
paragraphs.zh: 这篇文章为能源的未来绘制了两条道路。洛文斯称之为“艰难”道路，需要更多的能源供应来满足不断增长的需求。随着美国石油产量自1970年以来不断下降，煤炭和铀将通过在大型偏远设施发电来提供大部分增长。

paragraphs.en: Lovins instead championed a “soft” path that put people’s wants ahead of supplies. “People do not want electricity or oil … but rather comfortable rooms, light, vehicular motion … and other real things,” he wrote.
paragraphs.zh: 相反，洛文斯倡导一种"软"道路，将人们的需求置于供应之上。"人们不想要电或石油......而是想要舒适的房间、光线、车辆运动......和其他真实的东西，"他写道。

paragraphs.en: The soft path would meet those wants with a diverse array of renewable energy resources, sourced locally where possible. Heating would come from solar collectors and waste heat. Vehicles would be made more efficient and run on biofuels. Wind power would be used to compress air to drive machinery. Oil and gas would be reserved for making chemicals. Lovins hoped that matching form with function could enable U.S. energy use to plateau and then decline so that it could be supplied renewably by 2025.
paragraphs.zh: 软路径将通过各种可再生能源资源满足这些需求，在可能的情况下就地采购。供暖将来自太阳能收集器和废热。车辆将更高效，并使用生物燃料。风能将用于压缩空气以驱动机械。石油和天然气将用于制造化学品。Lovins希望将形式与功能相匹配可以使美国的能源使用达到稳定水平然后逐渐减少，这样到2025年就可以得到可再生的供应。

paragraphs.en: When Lovins wrote his article, most electricity was generated inefficiently from fossil fuels or uranium, while wind and solar power remained prohibitively expensive. “Photovoltaics were out of bounds intellectually; that gets you laughed out of the room, and I didn’t actually think they would get cheap enough,” Lovins told me in 2025.
paragraphs.zh: 当洛文斯写这篇文章的时候，大多数电力都是从化石燃料或铀中低效地产生的，而风能和太阳能仍然昂贵得令人望而却步。洛文斯在2025年告诉我："光化学在智力上是越界的;这让你笑出了房间，我真的不认为它们会变得足够便宜。"

paragraphs.en: Burning or fissioning a fuel to generate electricity inefficiently, transmitting it far away, and turning it back into low-grade heat for homes was “like cutting butter with a chainsaw,” Lovins wrote. Thus, his soft path included only a narrowing lane for electricity, steering it toward essential purposes such as electronics, subways, lighting and smelting. Lovins posited that “an affluent industrial economy could advantageously operate with no central power stations at all,” though he did not advocate going that far.
paragraphs.zh: 燃烧或裂变燃料以低效率地发电，将其传输到远处，并将其转化为家庭的低级热量，"就像用电锯切割黄油一样，" Lovins写道。因此，他的软路径只包括一条狭窄的电力通道，将其转向电子产品，地铁，洛文斯认为"一个富裕的工业经济可以在没有中央发电站的情况下有利地运作"，尽管他并不主张走得那么远。

paragraphs.en: The road taken
paragraphs.zh: 走过的道路

paragraphs.en: They were paths, not predictions, and neither path foretold the road actually taken in the 50 years since. Unlike most forecasts from the era, which projected ever-rising demand, the soft path foresaw that total U.S. energy use could plateau, and it almost exactly matched the actual level in 2000. However, Lovins and his contemporaries failed to foresee the drilling advances that have kept oil and gas dominant.
paragraphs.zh: 它们是路径，而不是预测，而且这两条路径都没有预测到此后50年实际采取的道路。与那个时代的大多数预测不同，预测需求将不断增长，软路径预测美国能源使用总量可能会趋于平稳，并且几乎与2000年的实际水平完全吻合。然而，洛文斯和他的同时代人未能预见到石油和天然气占主导地位的钻探进展。

paragraphs.en: As an environmental engineer completing a book about the visions that are shaping energy realities and opportunities around the world, I think Lovins got it half right about how to secure sustainable energy. Efficiency and renewable energy are indeed essential, but clean electricity and electrification are proving far more important than Lovins expected.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一名环境工程师，我正在完成一本关于塑造世界各地能源现实和机遇的愿景的书，我认为Lovins在如何确保可持续能源方面做对了一半。效率和可再生能源确实至关重要，但清洁电力和电气化被证明比Lovins预期的更重要。

paragraphs.en: Critics argued that Lovins underestimated the costs of clean technologies and overstated what they could achieve. In fact, opportunities for clean energy have been transformed by unanticipated plunges in the costs of wind and solar electricity, battery storage and LED lighting.
paragraphs.zh: 批评人士认为，洛文斯低估了清洁技术的成本，夸大了它们的成就。事实上，风能和太阳能发电、电池储能和LED照明成本的意外暴跌，已经改变了清洁能源的机会。

paragraphs.en: For example, the price per watt of solar panels tumbled from around US$100 in current dollars in 1976 to around 10 cents in global markets today and a President Donald Trump-set minimum price of 38 cents for panels imported to the United States.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，太阳能电池板的每瓦价格从1976年的100美元左右跌至今天全球市场的10美分左右，唐纳德·特朗普总统将进口到美国的电池板的最低价格定为38美分。

paragraphs.en: The soft path goes electric
paragraphs.zh: 柔软的道路变成了电动的

paragraphs.en: Modern technologies turn the chainsaw analogy on its head by making electrification the soft path to reducing energy use. Heat pumps supply several times as much heat as the electricity they consume. Induction stoves cook food far more efficiently than gas flames. And electric vehicles are a few times more efficient than gasoline ones.
paragraphs.zh: 现代技术彻底改变了电锯的比喻，使电气化成为减少能源使用的软途径。热泵提供的热量是其消耗的电力的数倍。感应炉烹饪食物的效率远远高于燃气火焰。电动汽车的效率是汽油汽车的几倍。

paragraphs.en: Powered by renewable electricity, from local resources like the solar panels on Lovins’ roof and mine, or from larger solar, wind and geothermal facilities, these technologies can slash fossil fuel use. A diversity of resources blended with high-voltage transmission and storage can make clean electricity available around the clock.
paragraphs.zh: 这些技术由可再生电力提供动力，来自当地资源，如Lovins屋顶和矿井上的太阳能电池板，或来自更大的太阳能，风能和地热设施，这些技术可以减少化石燃料的使用。各种资源与高压输电和储存相结合，可以全天候提供清洁电力。

paragraphs.en: When I visited Lovins’ ultra-efficient, solar-powered Colorado home in 2025, electrification took center stage. It was the induction stove that he showed off first, boiling water at lightning speed, then the batteries in the utility room. Two electric cars were charging outside. The wood stoves had been retired.
paragraphs.zh: 2025年，当我参观洛文斯在科罗拉多的超高效太阳能住宅时，电气化占据了中心舞台。他首先展示的是感应炉，它以闪电般的速度烧开水，然后是杂物间里的电池。两辆电动汽车正在外面充电。柴炉已经退役。

paragraphs.en: Former colleagues of Lovins now advocate an “electrotech revolution” centered on renewable electricity and increased electrification. Lovins told me he embraces their work but is pushing them to add integrative design — optimizing efficiency by redesigning whole systems — a subject he teaches at Stanford.
paragraphs.zh: 洛文斯的前同事现在倡导一场以可再生电力和增加电气化为中心的“电气技术革命”。洛文斯告诉我，他支持他们的工作，但正在推动他们增加综合设计--通过重新设计整个系统来优化效率--他在斯坦福大学教授的一门课程。

paragraphs.en: I believe Lovins was right to focus on matching resources with people’s actual needs. Renewable electrification and efficiency provide the softest path to doing so for the next 50 years.
paragraphs.zh: 我相信洛文斯把重点放在使资源与人们的实际需求相匹配上是正确的。可再生电气化和效率为未来50年提供了最温和的途径。
